prompt: A complete desktop website homepage design for 德億茶莊 DEYI TEA HOUSE, a Taiwanese tea house whose main product is 杉林溪烏龍茶 (Shanlinxi high-mountain oolong tea). Render the web page itself, flat and edge to edge, landscape 16:10 desktop (1440x900 composition). No browser window, no address bar, no device frame, no desk, no hands. STRUCTURE top to bottom: (1) A slim top navigation bar across the full width on a deep slate-teal ground: at far left the brand's square copper-orange carved seal stamp containing four Traditional Chinese characters 德億茶莊 arranged 2x2 (reproduce the seal from the reference image faithfully) next to the wordmark 'DEYI TEA HOUSE' in a stencil-cut geometric sans in cream; at right small cream text links 茶品 · 杉林溪 · 泡茶 · 門市 and a small solid copper button 'LINE 詢價'. (2) THE DOMINANT MOVE, the first viewport: the whole page ground is a topographic survey map of the Shanlinxi mountains printed in deep slate teal #2B4654, with fine hairline mist-cream contour lines (#D6E0DC) flowing across the entire page, a few contour lines labelled with tiny altitude numerals 1200, 1400, 1600, 1800. The terrain band above the 1600 contour is filled solid flat copper orange #C8834B as an altitude-tinted zone, labelled small '茶園 1,600m+'. Over the left-center of the map, a huge bold Traditional Chinese headline in a sharp, confident song/ming-style display typeface in cream: '杉林溪烏龍'. Beneath it a smaller line: '一千六百公尺雲霧裡長出來的茶。' and a short body paragraph at real reading size: '德億茶莊自家茶品。高山冷涼、雲霧多，茶湯甜、香氣清。挑好了，LINE 一聲就幫你寄。' Below that a cartographic map-legend box with a thin cream rule border containing: a solid copper button 'LINE 詢價訂購', a secondary line '或來電 0X-XXXX-XXXX', and a small green status dot '門市營業中 · 09:00–18:00'. (3) Along the right edge of the page, a slim vertical altimeter scale with tick marks from 0m at the bottom to 2000m at the top and one single copper triangle marker at 1,600m. (4) The bottom fifth of the image shows the start of the next section on the same map ground: section heading '本季茶品' in cream, and three teas placed as survey plot markers at different points on the contour map (not identical cards): each a small pin with a label block reading 杉林溪烏龍・春茶 / 杉林溪烏龍・冬茶 / 杉林溪・熟香烏龍, '四兩 150g', 'NT$ ——'. TYPE: Traditional Chinese throughout, crisp and legible, body text about 16px relative to a 1440px-wide page. PALETTE strictly: deep slate teal, copper orange, mist cream, near-black ink #142630. Matte printed-survey-map feel with very subtle paper grain. No photographs, no gradients, no glow, no tea-leaf clip art, no brush calligraphy, no awards, badges or certifications.
